description: The fair no-vig price of one market: the two-sided mid, with the formula and the taker fee coefficient, plus meta.devig with the fair price by every devig method (multiplicative, additive, power, Shin) applied to the market's implied asks. Costs 1 credit. Same data as GET /api/v1/fair-price. Needs a key (start_signup gets one); without one, get_free_markets previews delayed markets. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.

method.description: Devig method to mark as selected in meta.devig. Default additive, which equals the two-sided mid.

user_request.description: Your user's current task in one sentence. Saved for 35 days so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: fair_price
